notes:
Account: CypherForge Labs — small tooling shop building a JetBrains (IntelliJ/PyCharm) plugin that does local code indexing + LLM-backed completions. Evaluating Redwood for low-latency streaming and model/version pinning so users can pick internal fine-tuned variants.

Recent convo highlights:
- CTO (Marta Li) wants the plugin to run full-text and semantic search on developer machines but use private inference for heavy ops.
- "We need completions in <120ms 95th P90 for single-file edits; batch refactors can be slower." — Marta.
- Preference for open Llama-family models but must support fallback to hosted high-quality model during spikes.

Technical constraints / asks:
- Local index agent that keeps per-repo embeddings on disk, encrypted at rest (customer-managed KMS).
- Offline-first UX: IDE should be functional when laptop disconnected (read-only completions from cache).
- Model pinning: devs should be able to pin a model SHA for reproducible completions across CI and developers.
- Streaming: token-by-token streaming into JetBrains UI, ability to cancel mid-generation.
- Latency SLOs: 50-120ms for single-line completion (local cache path), 300-600ms for multi-line/code-synthesis via private endpoint.

Commercial/Operational notes:
- Interested in Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput at scale, but legal prefers Private (VPC/on-prem) for initial POC.
- Cost sensitivity moderate; willing to trade cost for deterministic latency and auditability.
